CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  May 6, 2024

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:01 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall,
  and via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Dorado, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Pham, Tsujii, Garcia, Olson

  Absent:  None

  Commissioner Mojarro arrived at 7:14 P.M.

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Maia McCurley, Principal Planner;
  Yalini Siva, Senior Planner; Erica Vega, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Olson

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – April 1, 2024 (7:03 P.M.)
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to approve
  the Minutes of the April 1, 2024, Regular Meeting of the Alhambra
  Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the April 1, 2024, Regular Meeting of the
  Alhambra Planning Commission.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Vice President Garcia, Seconded by Commissioner Grijalva.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Dorado, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Pham, Tsujii, Garcia,
  Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: Mojarro

  ITEM 2:  EXTENSION FOR PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-22-18
  AND CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CUP-22-07 (7:04 P.M.)
  1
  05/06/2024
   •  Request: This is a request for a one-year extension for the previously
  approved Planned Development Permit PD-22-18 and Conditional
  Use Permit CUP-22-07 to demolish an approximately 3,444 square
  foot existing commercial building and construct a new 3,364 square
  foot, automated express car wash with three (3) free-standing shade
  canopies on an approximately 29,838 square foot site located in the
  CMU (Commercial Mixed-Use) zone.
  •  Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 24-08 approving a
  one-year extension to July 28, 2025, for the previously approved
  Planned Development Permit PD-22-18 and Conditional Use Permit
  CUP-22-07 subject to the Conditions of Approval, and finding the
  one-year extension for Planned Development Permit PD-22-18 and
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-22-07 to be exempt from review under
  the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to
  Section 15332, Class 32 of Title 14 of the California Code of
  Regulations, which exempts from CEQA review projects
  characterized as in-fill development..

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 2.
  •  Moved by Vice President Garcia, Seconded by Commissioner Grijalva.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 8-0-0-2
  Ayes:  Dorado, Gardea, Grijalva, Juarez, Pham, Tsujii, Garcia,
  Olson
  Noes:  None
  Recused: Ho
  Absent: Mojarro

  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio and video
  recordings of the discussion is available here:
  Audio:
  PC Meeting – May 6, 2024 (Audio).m4a
  Video:
  PC Meeting – May 6, 2024 (Video).mp4

E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  •  There were no Discussion Items.

F.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 3:  ZONING TEXT AMENDMENT AMD-24-01 (7:05 P.M.)
  • Citywide
  2
  05/06/2024
   •  Applicant: City of Alhambra
  •  Request: This is an application for Zoning Text Amendment AMD-
  24-01 amending various sections of the Alhambra Municipal Code on
  zoning, as well as adding new sections, to address new State
  legislation and clarify ambiguous provisions.
  •  Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 24-09 recommending
  that the City Council adopt Zoning Text Amendment AMD-24-01, an
  ordinance amending various sections of the Alhambra Municipal
  Code on zoning, as well as adding new sections, to address new State
  legislation and clarify ambiguous provisions, and finding Zoning Text
  Amendment AMD-24-01 to be exempt from review under the
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Sections
  15060(c)(2) and 15061(b)(3) of Title 14 of the California Code of
  Regulations, which exempts from CEQA review projects that will not
  result in a direct or reasonably foreseeable indirect physical change in
  the environment and that have no possibility of causing a significant
  effect on the environment, respectively.
  •  Principal Planner Maia McCurley provided the Staff presentation.
  •  The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  •  Public Comments:
  1.) John La Raia
  2.) Lewis McCammon

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Agenda Item 3 with the following recommended
  changes to AMD-24-01:
  1.) §23.22.220(B)(1)(c): Strike “Major Arterial” from the location
  requirement for Personal Storage uses.
  2.) §23.06.020: Change the land use regulation requirement for Personal
  Storage uses in the I (Industrial) zone from “M” (Minor Use Permit)
  to “C” (Conditional Use Permit).
  3.) §23.22.220(B)(2): Require a minimum of 50% of the ground floor
  with a minimum depth of 20 feet within Personal Storage facilities be
  dedicated to Public/Semi-Public Uses, Commercial Uses, or
  combination thereof, except Storage, Warehousing, and Wholesaling
  Uses.
  4.) §23.22.220(C)(1): Combine subsections (a) and (c) into one
  subsection in order to combine landscaping, open space, and urban
  furniture community benefits into one requirement.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Vice President Garcia.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 6-4-0-0
  Ayes:  Dorado, Gardea, Grijalva, Pham, Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Tsujii
  Abstain: None
  Absent: None
  3
  05/06/2024

  REPORTS:

  •  President Olson welcomed Commissioner Dorado to the Planning Commission.
  (8:21 P.M.)

  •  Commissioner Dorado recognized the work done by the Planning Commission over
  the last two years. (8:21 P.M.)

J.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:22 P.M. to Monday,
  June 3, 2024, at 7:00 P.M.

  Chris Olson
